name: What is the typical process for double hung window replacement?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for double hung window replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: The replacement process typically begins with an initial consultation and measurement, followed by material selection and ordering. Once your new windows arrive, our team will remove your old windows, prepare the openings, and meticulously install the new double hung units. This includes proper sealing, insulation, and trim work to ensure a weather-tight and aesthetically pleasing finish. Finally, we conduct a thorough cleanup and a final inspection with you to ensure satisfaction. The entire process aims to minimize disruption to your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, measurement, ordering, removal of old windows, installation of new double hung units, sealing, trimming, and a final inspection.
